items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1964-04-25
items.q: But Braun was a musician. I want to tell you that. He could turn his band into a good ragtime band because he knew his business.

ctx.x: But Braun was a musician. I want to tell you that. He could turn his band into a good ragtime band because he knew his business.
Let me ask you this. How long had you been playing for money before Buddy Bolden became well known? Oh, quite a while. Quite a while?
